name: Sphere Light Sampling with Multiple Strategies
definition: Calculates direct lighting from a spherical light source using Monte Carlo integration with various sampling strategies (Importance Solid Angle, Importance Surface Area, Uniform Solid Angle, etc.).
summary: Sphere Light Sampling with Multiple Strategies estimates direct lighting from spherical lights using Monte Carlo integration, distinguished by its framework supporting diverse sampling techniques like uniform, importance, and cosine-weighted methods.
